cause: The new isolated contract tool layer installed pinned Semgrep without first installing its pinned uv bootstrap. Mise fell back to missing pipx; this failed before any fast-check verdict.

diagnostic.definition: CLI-only modified bootstrap definition, clone source 0aef6f4e696d63013a56b2673d304201a11a47f9; no suite verdict or GitHub publisher, not counted as coverage.

fix: Install the existing mise.toml uv=0.5.5 pin and expose its bin path before pipx:semgrep=1.137.0.

second_failure.cause: The source clone preserved HEAD history but lacked origin/develop. The route fetched it in a filesystem:false task, so semver-diff could not see the protected comparison ref. Circle same-SHA job 5633976 passed the full suite.
second_failure.fix: Use the original target-branch resolver, fetch its protected ref in the shared runner, bind target and merge-base revisions, and verify the target does not change during execution. Actual single-branch Git clone regression proves the missing-ref failure and fetch correction.
